title.narrative: KVA SSEESS Support, 2010-2012 Swedish Secretariat for Environmental Earth System Sciences

description.narrative: Stöd till sekretariatet för miljö och resursfrågor, SSEESS, vid KVA för att underlätta svenska forskares väg in i internationella forskningsprogram för hållbar utveckling. Stöd till sekundering och konferensstöd.

Support to the Swedish Secretariat for Global Environmental Earth System Sciences (SSEESS) at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, KVA, in order to facilitate for Swedish researchers' participation in international research programmes for sustainable development. Support to secondment and conference support

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: According to the aim with Sida's partnership to strengthen research capacity within all areas of interdisciplinary Global Environmental Change (GEC) research, SSESS followed the implementation of its strategy within the activities of the extension period. SSESS have focused on building and strengthening networks of GEC research scientists in Sweden and increasingly from developing countries, as well as supporting Swedish researchers within the Swedsh Research for Development agenda. SSESS has provided a platform to inform and increase awareness about the global and regional GEC programme and initiatives among both Swedish and scientists from developing countries. SSESS also managed to use its Research Links and North-South travel grant in a strategic way to build collaborations with its supported research programmes and organizations.
These results are in line with Sida’s strategic aim in supporting this partnership with SSESS as well as the expected results according to the agreement.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
